description.zh:
◆ 身为君主时，势力采用默认策略【超世之杰】

◆ 每个月势力策略点增加10，科技点增加10


◆ 个人被俘概率降低

◆ 在军团战中统领的小队攻击力和防御力各增加10%
description.en:
◆ As Ruler, faction adopts default Strategy 【Peerless Hero】



◆ +10 Faction Strategy Points and +10 Tech Points per month





◆ Reduced personal capture chance



◆ +10% Attack and Defense for commanded squads in Legion Battles

description.zh: ◆ 青州兵部队上限加1，自身部队为青州兵时攻击力提高10%
description.en: ◆ +1 Qing Province Infantry unit cap, +10% Attack when own unit is Qing Province Infantry

description.zh: 资金收入提高120%，每日下降10点民心，所有城市街区每日下降10点商业值。
description.en: Funds Income increased by 120%, Popularity decreases by 10 per day, all city district Commerce decreases by 10 per day.

description.zh: 某相邻非同盟势力的部队一旦抵达我方城市，会立刻撤退，持续两个月
description.en: Whenever troops from an adjacent non-Alliance Faction arrive at Our City, they will immediately retreat. Lasts 2 months.

description.zh: 直接将700策略点兑现为15000金,  存入君主所在城市。
description.en: Directly convert 700 Strategy Points into 15,000 Gold, deposited in the Ruler's city.

description.zh: 己方部队在大地图上的移动速度增加15%。
description.en: Allied Unit Move Speed on the World Map increased by 15%.

description.zh: 消耗一个月时间，降低选中势力与其他全部势力的关系值9%。
description.en: Spends 1 month to reduce the Relationship Score between the selected Faction and all other Factions by 9%.

description2.zh: 自己和自部队60米半径范围内的自势力部队攻击，防御和速度各提高30%。
description2.en: Increases Attack, Defense, and Speed by 30% each for self and own faction units within a 60m radius.

description2.zh: 自身30米范围内的敌军陷入智略性混乱。
description2.en: Inflicts INT-based Chaos on enemies within 30m of self.

description2.zh: 50半径范围内的敌军陷入无阵状态30秒，防御力和移动速度降低20%。
description2.en: Enemies within a 50m radius enter the No Formation state for 30 sec, reducing Defense and Move Speed by 20%.

description2.zh: 50半径范围内的敌军陷入无阵状态30秒。
description2.en: Enemies within a radius of 50 enter No Formation state for 30 seconds.

description2.zh: 自身攻击力破坏力提高60%，速度提升20%。
description2.en: Increases own Attack and Siege Damage by 60% and Speed by 20%.

description2.zh: 自身防御增加30%，当士气小于100时，自身士气每秒增加1点，持续60秒。
description2.en: Increases own Defense by 30%. When Morale is below 100, gains 1 Morale per sec for 60 sec.

description2.zh: 自身和50米半径范围内的自势力部队攻击和防御各提高20%。
description2.en: Increases Attack and Defense of self and own Faction units within a 50m radius by 20%.

description2.zh: 80米范围内某个目标防御力、速度减少30%。
description2.en: Reduces the Defense and Speed of a target within 80m by 30%.

description2.zh: 剑系绝学，将真气化为真气之酒，洗涤自身，并同时造成敌人技穷。
description2.en: A sword art that transforms Qi into spirit wine, purifying oneself and inflicting Exhaustion on enemies.

description2.zh: 以气御力。使一名友方单位在短时间内拥有可用真气抵挡部分伤害的能力。
description2.en: Control force with Qi. Grant an ally the ability to absorb partial damage using Qi for a short time.

description2.zh: 挥剑将真气斩出，伤敌于千里之外。
description2.en: Unleash sword Qi to strike enemies from a great distance.

description2.zh: 回避牌，使用时摸三张牌。
description2.en: Evade Card. On use, draw 3 cards.

description2.zh: 消除自身所有负面状态，同时弃置任意手牌并摸取弃置手牌数加一的牌数。
description2.en: Remove all debuffs from yourself, discard any number of cards from your hand, and draw cards equal to the number of discarded cards plus one.

description2.zh: 特殊攻击牌，造成1.2倍杀伤，命中后造成目标势竭状态，每回合损失形势值，持续2回合。
description2.en: Special Attack Card. Deals 1.2x damage. On hit, inflicts Exhaustion on the target, causing Momentum loss each turn for 2 turns.

description2.zh: 特殊攻击牌，造成1.2倍杀伤，命中后获得50点灵感。
description2.en: Special Attack Card. Deals 1.2x damage. On hit, gain 50 Inspiration.

description2.zh: 本回合内所有攻击牌可额外选择一个目标。
description2.en: All Attack Cards can select 1 additional target this turn.

description2.zh: 丢弃两张牌，自身恢复3.2倍攻击的形势值。
description2.en: Discard 2 cards. Recover Momentum equal to 3.2x Attack for yourself.

description2.zh: 自身损失2.2倍攻击的形势值，为队友恢复3.5倍攻击的形势值。
description2.en: Lose Momentum equal to 2.2x Attack, and recover Momentum equal to 3.5x Attack for a teammate.

description2.zh: 每次使用技能时，对自己和周围50米范围的友军添加攻击状态，攻击力增加15%，持续30秒钟
description2.en: Each time a skill is used, grants Attack status to self and allies within 50m, increasing Attack by 15% for 30 seconds

description2.zh: 每次使用技能时，对自己和周围50米范围的友军添加守御状态，防御力增加15%，持续30秒钟
description2.en: Each time a skill is used, grants Defense status to self and allies within 50m, increasing Defense by 15% for 30 seconds

description2.zh: 当士气不足100时, 每秒恢复1点士气
description2.en: When Morale is below 100, restores 1 Morale per second

description2.zh: 回合开始对周围3米范围内的友军和自身防御，攻击，暴击率提升。
description2.en: At turn start, increases Defense, Attack, and Crit for self and allies within 3m.

description2.zh: 受击时摸一张牌，并增加一层【枭雄】状态，最高3层，每层增加8*n%攻击力（n为当前手牌类型数量），持续一回合。
description2.en: When hit, draw 1 card and gain 1 stack of 【Warlord's Might】 (max 3 stacks, each stack increases Attack by 8*n%, where n is the number of card types in hand), lasting 1 turn.

description.zh: 与青釭剑一同铸出，并与之齐名并称绝世双剑。传为《大言赋》中名句“拔长剑兮倚长天”命名之。唯有王相之人方可驭其气也。
description.en: Forged alongside the Qinggang Sword, the two were hailed as peerless twin swords. Said to be named after the famous line ‘Draw the long sword and lean upon the heavens’ from the ‘Rhapsody on Great Words’. Only those destined for kingship can command its aura.

description.zh: 在山纹甲外披有极其罕见的龙纹长衣，或许暗示了此甲主人的雄心壮志。
description.en: Mountain-pattern armor draped with an extremely rare dragon-patterned robe, perhaps hinting at its owner's grand ambitions.

description.zh: 为冠的边缘进行过镀金处理的巧士冠。
description.en: A Qiaoshi Crown with gilded edges.

description.zh: 因此马飞奔迅猛，其影子都难以跟上，于是便叫做绝影。虽然命名中抱有其主美好的希冀，但绝影也未让其失望，有伯乐称此马为汗血宝马，更有其者目睹此马身中三箭仍能奋蹄疾驰，扬尘而去。
description.en: This steed ran so swiftly that even its own shadow could not keep pace, hence its name, Shadow Runner. Though the name carried its master's high hopes, Shadow Runner never disappointed. Connoisseurs acclaimed it as a blood-sweating steed, and some even witnessed it gallop furiously after taking three arrows, speeding away in a cloud of dust.

desc.zh: 出自姬姓，周文王之子曹叔振铎后裔，沛国谯郡顶级望族。曹魏皇族，曹操统一北方，曹丕代汉建魏。与夏侯氏世代联姻，构成曹魏政权核心。高平陵之变后，曹氏皇权逐渐为司马氏架空并最终被其取代。
desc.en: Originating from the Ji clan, descendants of Cao Shu Zhenduo, son of King Wen of Zhou, and a premier prominent clan of Qiao in the State of Pei. The imperial house of Cao Wei, Cao Cao unified the North, and Cao Pi replaced Han to establish Wei. Bound by generations of intermarriage with the Xiahou clan, they formed the core of the Cao Wei regime. After the Incident at Gaoping Tombs, the imperial power of the Cao clan was gradually hollowed out by the Sima clan and ultimately usurped.

name.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

desc.zh: 曹操似乎有事情想拜托你（最早的任务，未二次修改）
desc.en: Cao Cao seems to have a favor to ask of you. (Earliest quest, not yet revised)

desc.zh:
王允大摆寿宴，实则是要设计诛杀董卓，前往洛阳参加王允的寿宴。

禁忌条件：主角为王允、曹操、曹操亲属、李儒、董璜、董晏、董白、吕布、高顺、李傕、郭汜、华雄时无法触发

亲历条件：【和王允的关系等级至少为1级】且【与董卓的关系等级不到2级】
desc.en:
Wang Yun hosts a lavish birthday banquet, though his true intent is to scheme and assassinate Dong Zhuo. Travel to Luoyang to attend Wang Yun's banquet.



Restrictions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Wang Yun, Cao Cao, a relative of Cao Cao, Li Ru, Dong Huang, Dong Yan, Dong Bai, Lu Bu, Gao Shun, Li Jue, Guo Si, or Hua Xiong



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Wang Yun is at least Level 1】 and 【Relationship level with Dong Zhuo is less than Level 2】

desc.zh:
曹操逃出洛阳不久后，又在中牟县附近被捕，前往此地调查，寻求解救他的办法。

禁忌条件：主角为董卓、吕布、曹操、曹操亲属或陈宫时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与董卓的关系等级不足2级】且【曾亲历过七星宝刀剧情】

逆天改命：【使陈宫成为家将】
desc.en:
Shortly after fleeing Luoyang, Cao Cao was captured near Zhongmu County. Travel there to investigate and seek a way to rescue him.



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Dong Zhuo, Lu Bu, Cao Cao, a relative of Cao Cao, or Chen Gong.



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Dong Zhuo is below 2】 and 【Previously experienced the Seven Star Sword storyline】



Defy Fate: 【Make Chen Gong a Retainer】

desc.zh:
董卓
挟天子后在朝中横行霸道，逃出洛阳的曹操欲发布号令召集天下英雄联合讨贼。

触发条件：曹操、袁绍、袁术、孙坚、公孙瓒、韩馥、张杨、刘表等诸侯存活。刘关张三人存活。

                    洛阳、长安属董卓，陈留属曹操，长沙属孙坚，襄阳属刘表，袁绍、公孙瓒、韩馥为君主。

亲历条件：【身属董卓，孙坚，曹操，刘备，公孙瓒或袁术势力】

逆天改命：【<联盟军>救下潘凤并使其成为家将】，【<董卓势力>救下华雄并使其成为家将】，【<孙坚势力>救下孙坚】
desc.en:
Dong Zhuo

runs rampant at court after holding the emperor hostage. Having fled Luoyang, Cao Cao seeks to issue a call to arms, rallying the realm's heroes to unite and punish the traitor.



Trigger Condition: Warlords such as Cao Cao, Yuan Shao, Yuan Shu, Sun Jian, Gongsun Zan, Han Fu, Zhang Yang, and Liu Biao are alive. Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei are alive.



                    Luoyang and Changan belong to Dong Zhuo, Chenliu belongs to Cao Cao, Changsha belongs to Sun Jian, and Xiangyang belongs to Liu Biao. Yuan Shao, Gongsun Zan, and Han Fu are Rulers.



Participation Conditions: 【Serve in Dong Zhuo, Sun Jian, Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Gongsun Zan, or Yuan Shu's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Coalition Forces>Rescue Pan Feng and recruit him as a Retainer】, 【<Dong Zhuo's Faction>Rescue Hua Xiong and recruit him as a Retainer】, 【<Sun Jian's Faction>Save Sun Jian】

desc.zh:
一心寻仇的曹操将全部兵力向徐州开拨，却没想到后方根据地遭到了吕布占领...

触发条件：曹操、吕布存活。濮阳属吕布、曹操势力存活。

亲历条件：【身属曹操、吕布势力】
desc.en:
Bent on vengeance, Cao Cao marches all his troops toward Xu Province, never expecting that his base in the rear would be seized by Lu Bu...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao and Lu Bu are alive. Puyang belongs to Lu Bu, Cao Cao's Faction survives.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Cao Cao or Lu Bu's Faction】

desc.zh:
李傕、郭汜二人在长安火并，贾诩秘密召集天下能士协助献帝东归洛阳...

触发条件：李傕、曹操、贾诩存活。贾诩属李傕，长安属李傕、洛阳属曹操。

禁忌条件：主角为李傕时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】且【主角不为曹操】
desc.en:
Li Jue and Guo Si clash violently in Changan. Secretly, Jia Xu gathers capable talents from across the realm to assist Emperor Xian in returning east to Luoyang...



Trigger Condition: Li Jue, Cao Cao, and Jia Xu are alive. Jia Xu belongs to Li Jue, Changan belongs to Li Jue, and Luoyang belongs to Cao Cao.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Li Jue.



Participation Condition: 【Affiliated with Cao Cao's Faction】 and 【Protagonist is not Cao Cao】

desc.zh: 徐晃荀攸满宠加入曹操
desc.en: Xu Huang, Xun You, and Man Chong join Cao Cao

desc.zh:
经历多日波折后，献帝终于重返洛阳。惊魂未定，当今第一权臣又提出了新的要求，迁都。

触发条件：曹操存活。洛阳属曹操、许昌属曹操。

禁忌条件：主角是徐晃、韩暹、杨奉时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】
desc.en:
After many days of hardship, Emperor Xian finally returns to Luoyang. Yet before the dust has settled, the realm's foremost minister makes a new demand: relocate the capital.



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao is alive. Luoyang belongs to Cao Cao, Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao.



Restricted Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Xu Huang, Han Xian, or Yang Feng.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】

desc.zh:
在曹操挟天子后，其势力逐渐壮大，眼下盘踞宛城的张绣已成肘腋之患...

禁忌条件：主角为曹操，曹昂、张绣、邹氏时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】、【许昌属曹操、宛城属张绣】，【曹操，曹昂，张绣，邹氏存活且在正确势力下】

逆天改命：【<曹操势力>救下典韦和曹昂，使邹氏成为家将】
desc.en:
After Cao Cao held the emperor hostage, his faction steadily grew in power. Now, Zhang Xiu, entrenched in Wancheng, has become an imminent threat...



Exclusion Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Cao Ang, Zhang Xiu, or Lady Zou.



Participation Conditions: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao, Wancheng belongs to Zhang Xiu】, 【Cao Cao, Cao Ang, Zhang Xiu, and Lady Zou are alive and in their correct Factions】



Defy Fate: 【<Cao Cao's Faction> Save Dian Wei and Cao Ang, and recruit Lady Zou as Retainer】

desc.zh:
身为曹操侍卫的王图将赴死地，来莺儿不忍永别，唯有寻得说服曹操之人，化解次劫。

禁忌条件：主角为来莺儿或曹操时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与来莺儿关系等级至少为2级且不足5级】，【来莺儿不是情人或恋人】，【身属曹操势力】或【与曹操的关系等级至少为2级】，访问来莺儿触发

逆天改命：【将来莺儿收为家将】
desc.en:
Wang Tu, a guard serving Cao Cao, is bound for death. Unable to bear an eternal parting, Lai Ying'er must find someone who can persuade Cao Cao and avert this disaster.



Restricted Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Lai Ying'er or Cao Cao.



Participation Requirements: 【Relationship level with Lai Ying'er is at least Level 2 and below Level 5】, 【Lai Ying'er is not a Lover or Beloved】, 【Belongs to Cao Cao's Faction】 or 【Relationship level with Cao Cao is at least Level 2】, triggered by visiting Lai Ying'er



Defy Fate: 【Recruit Lai Ying'er as Retainer】

desc.zh:
公孙瓒死后，公孙玥继续在北疆率领少量白马义从抗击胡人......

禁忌条件：主角为公孙玥、阎柔、田畴时无法触发。

亲历条件：【公孙玥、阎柔、田畴存活，公孙瓒、刘虞死亡】，【公孙玥为在野状态】，【与公孙玥的关系等级至少为3级】，【与田畴的关系等级小于2级】，【与阎柔的关系等级小于2级或主角为曹操】。

逆天改命：【收公孙玥、阎柔、田畴为家将】
desc.en:
Following Gongsun Zan's death, Gongsun Yue continues to lead a small band of White Horse Volunteers on the northern frontier to resist the Hu barbarians...



Incompatible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Gongsun Yue, Yan Rou, or Tian Chou.



Participation Requirements: 【Gongsun Yue, Yan Rou, and Tian Chou are alive, Gongsun Zan and Liu Yu are dead】, 【Gongsun Yue is Free】, 【Relationship level with Gongsun Yue is at least Level 3】, 【Relationship level with Tian Chou is below Level 2】, 【Relationship level with Yan Rou is below Level 2, or the protagonist is Cao Cao】.



Defy Fate: 【Recruit Gongsun Yue, Yan Rou, and Tian Chou as Retainers】

desc.zh:
曹操挟天子以令诸侯，献帝又一次成为了权臣的傀儡。数日后，国舅董承收到一封密诏...

触发条件：曹操、刘备存活。许昌属曹操。

禁忌条件：主角是董承时无法触发剧情。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】或【在野状态下与董承关系等级至少为2级】
desc.en:
Cao Cao held the emperor hostage to command the warlords in his name, and Emperor Xian once again became the puppet of a powerful minister. Several days later, Imperial In-law Dong Cheng received a secret decree...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao and Liu Bei are alive. Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Dong Cheng.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Cao Cao Faction】 or 【Free, with a Relationship level of at least Level 2 with Dong Cheng】

name.en: Riding Alone for a Thousand Li

desc.zh:
报答了曹操恩情的关羽，在得知兄长去处后，决定即刻护送二位嫂嫂出发。

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、甘梅、糜贞存活。许昌属曹操。

禁忌条件：主角是甘梅、糜贞、周仓时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与关羽的关系等级至少为2级】，【不在曹操势力】或【主角为关羽】
desc.en:
Having repaid Cao Cao's kindness, Guan Yu learns of his elder brother's whereabouts and resolves to escort his two sisters-in-law on their journey at once.



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Gan Mei, and Mi Zhen are alive. Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Gan Mei, Mi Zhen, or Zhou Cang.



Participation Condition: 【Relationship level with Guan Yu is at least Level 2】, 【Not in Cao Cao's Faction】 or 【Protagonist is Guan Yu】

desc.zh:
进入邺城后，曹丕遇到洛神甄姬，想占为己有......

禁忌条件：主角为甄宓丈夫，曹操，曹丕，甄宓，刘氏，袁绍，袁谭，袁熙，袁尚时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】、【甄宓为其他势力武将】、【甄宓，曹丕，曹操存活】且【邺城属曹操】

逆天改命：【<与甄宓的关系等级达到2级>阻止曹丕强娶甄宓，并使甄宓成为家将】
desc.en:
Upon entering Yecheng, Cao Pi encounters Lady Zhen, peerless as the Luo River Goddess, and desires to take her for himself...



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Lady Zhen's husband, Cao Cao, Cao Pi, Lady Zhen, Lady Liu, Yuan Shao, Yuan Tan, Yuan Xi, or Yuan Shang.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Lady Zhen is an Officer of another Faction】, 【Lady Zhen, Cao Pi, and Cao Cao are alive】, and 【Yecheng belongs to Cao Cao】



Defy Fate: 【<Relationship level with Lady Zhen reaches Level 2> Prevent Cao Pi from forcing Lady Zhen into marriage, and recruit Lady Zhen as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
邺城已破，冀州唾手可得，然而曹军中的两名功臣却在胜利前夕争的不可开交...

禁忌条件：主角为曹操，许褚，许攸时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】、【许褚与许攸为曹操势力武将】、【曹操占领邺城】且【曹操势力至少有8名武将】

逆天改命：【<与许攸的关系等级达到2级> 救下许攸，使其成为家将】
desc.en:
Ye has fallen, and Ji Province is within easy grasp, yet on the eve of triumph, two meritorious officers in Cao Cao's army are locked in a bitter feud...



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Xu Chu, or Xu You.



Participation Conditions: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Xu Chu and Xu You are Officers in Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Cao Cao occupies Ye】, and 【Cao Cao's Faction has at least 8 Officers】



Defy Fate: 【<Relationship level with Xu You reaches Level 2> Rescue Xu You and recruit him as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
曹操即将向南方推进，刘备等人身处孤城，生死较量已迫在眉睫...

亲历条件：【身属刘备势力】，【刘关张、赵云、诸葛亮、曹操存活】，【新野属刘备，许昌属曹操】
desc.en:
Cao Cao prepares to advance toward the south. Trapped in an isolated city, Liu Bei and his companions face an imminent struggle for survival...



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Liu Bei's Faction】, 【Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, and Cao Cao are alive】, 【Xinye belongs to Liu Bei, and Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao】

desc.zh:
刘琮秘不发丧，将荆州拱手献给曹操，曹操命虎豹骑星夜疾驰围堵新野的刘备...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、赵云、诸葛亮、甘梅、糜贞存活。襄阳属曹操，新野、江夏属刘备。

禁忌条件：主角是甘梅、糜贞时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备势力】

逆天改命：【<刘备势力><与糜贞关系等级达到3级>使糜贞存活并使其成为恋人并加入家族】
desc.en:
Liu Cong concealed his father's death and surrendered Jing Province to Cao Cao. Cao Cao then ordered the Tiger Cavalry to ride through the night to encircle Liu Bei at Xinye...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Gan Mei, and Mi Zhen are alive. Xiangyang belongs to Cao Cao, Xinye and Jiangxia belong to Liu Bei.



Restriction: Cannot be triggered if the protagonist is Gan Mei or Mi Zhen.



Participation Requirement: 【Belong to Liu Bei's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Liu Bei Faction><Relationship level with Mi Zhen reaches Level 3> Ensure Mi Zhen survives, make her your Beloved, and have her join your Family】

desc.zh:
曹操百万大军兵临江东，于赤壁港口搭建水寨并日夜操练，刘备听从谋士的建议与孙权联手抗曹...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、赵云，诸葛亮、孙权、周瑜存活。襄阳、新野属曹操，江夏属刘备，柴桑、建业属孙权。

禁忌条件：主角是庞统时无法触发。

人数条件：刘备势力至少需要2名额外文武官，孙权势力至少需要3名额外文官，曹操势力至少需要6名额外武官

亲历条件：【身属刘备或孙权势力】
desc.en:
With an army of a million men bearing down on Jiangdong, Cao Cao constructed a naval fortress at the port of Chibi and drilled his forces day and night. Liu Bei followed his strategist's advice and joined forces with Sun Quan to resist Cao Cao...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, and Zhou Yu are alive. Xiangyang and Xinye belong to Cao Cao, Jiangxia belongs to Liu Bei, Chaisang and Jianye belong to Sun Quan.



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Pang Tong.



Personnel Condition: Liu Bei's Faction requires at least 2 additional Scholars or Warriors, Sun Quan's Faction requires at least 3 additional Scholars, and Cao Cao's Faction requires at least 6 additional Warriors



Participation Requirement: 【Belong to Liu Bei or Sun Quan's Faction】

desc.zh:
曹操百万大军兵临江东，于赤壁港口搭建水寨并日夜操练，刘备听从谋士的建议与孙权联手抗曹...

触发条件：曹操、刘关张、赵云，诸葛亮、孙权、周瑜存活。襄阳、新野属曹操，江夏属刘备，柴桑、建业属孙权。

禁忌条件：主角是庞统时无法触发。

人数条件：刘备势力至少需要2名额外文武官，孙权势力至少需要3名额外文官，曹操势力至少需要6名额外武官

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】

逆天改命：【<曹操势力>占领江夏和柴桑】
desc.en:
Cao Cao's army of one million bore down on Jiangdong, constructing a naval fortress at the port of Chibi and drilling day and night. Heeding the counsel of his strategists, Liu Bei allied with Sun Quan to resist Cao Cao...



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, and Zhou Yu are alive. Xiangyang and Xinye belong to Cao Cao, Jiangxia belongs to Liu Bei, and Chaisang and Jianye belong to Sun Quan.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Pang Tong.



Personnel Requirement: Liu Bei's Faction requires at least 2 additional Scholars or Warriors, Sun Quan's Faction requires at least 3 additional Scholars, Cao Cao's Faction requires at least 6 additional Warriors



Participation Condition: 【Affiliated with Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Cao Cao's Faction> Occupy Jiangxia and Chaisang】

name.en: Zuo Ci's Tricks on Cao Cao

desc.zh:
贡橘途中离奇失踪，周遭相传为道士方术所为。若前往一探究竟，定有新奇遭遇。

禁忌条件：主角为曹操、左慈时无法触发

亲历条件：【与左慈和曹操的关系等级至少为2级】【曹操势力下至少有1名武官】

逆天改命：【获得遁甲天书】
desc.en:
Tribute oranges mysteriously vanish en route, and rumors spread that a Taoist's sorcery is to blame. If one investigates the matter, an extraordinary encounter surely awaits.



Ineligible Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao or Zuo Ci



Participation Condition: 【Relationship level with Zuo Ci and Cao Cao is at least Level 2】【At least 1 Warrior under Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【Obtain Book of Heavenly Evasions】

desc.zh:
距赤壁失利已有三年之久，经过数年的深思熟虑，曹操认为当下去除西北的威胁乃重中之重。

触发条件：曹操、马超存活。许昌属曹操，天水、长安属马超。曹操势力至少有10名武将。

亲历条件：【身属曹操或马超势力】
desc.en:
Three years have passed since the defeat at Chibi. After years of deliberate consideration, Cao Cao deems eliminating the threat from the northwest to be of utmost priority.



Trigger Condition: Cao Cao and Ma Chao are alive. Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao, Tianshui and Changan belong to Ma Chao. Cao Cao's Faction has at least 10 Officers.



Participation Requirements: 【Belongs to Cao Cao's or Ma Chao's Faction】

desc.zh:
传言天水城中遭遇叛乱，有急信求援，若要相助请及时前往。

亲历条件：【与王异关系等级不足5级】，【与赵昂的关系等级不足5级】，【身属曹操势力】，【天水属曹操】

逆天改命：使王异成为家将
desc.en:
Rumors circulate that a rebellion has erupted in Tianshui, and an urgent plea for aid has arrived. If you wish to assist, make haste.



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Wang Yi is below Level 5】, 【Relationship level with Zhao Ang is below Level 5】, 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Tianshui belongs to Cao Cao】



Defy Fate: Recruit Wang Yi as a Retainer

desc.zh:
夺得汉中的曹操开始靠近益州边界寻找图取的机会，刘备听从众谋士的建议决定主动出击...

触发条件：刘备、张飞、诸葛亮、曹操存活。长安、汉中属曹操，成都属刘备。

禁忌条件：主角是王平时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备或曹操势力】

逆天改命：【<曹操势力>救下夏侯渊】
desc.en:
Having seized Hanzhong, Cao Cao draws near the borders of Yi Province in search of an opportunity to strike. Listening to the counsel of his advisors, Liu Bei resolves to take the initiative and attack...



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Zhuge Liang, and Cao Cao are alive. Changan and Hanzhong belong to Cao Cao, Chengdu belongs to Liu Bei.



Exclusion Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Wang Ping.



Participation Condition: 【Affiliated with Liu Bei's or Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Cao Cao's Faction> Rescue Xiahou Yuan】

desc.zh:
刘备势力鼎盛，而曹军在汉中战事不利，局势动荡。关羽北上襄樊，意欲扩大战果...

触发条件：刘关张、关平、曹操、曹仁、孙权存活。成都、汉中属刘备，襄阳属曹操，江夏属孙权。孙权势力至少有5名武将。

禁忌条件：主角是糜芳、傅士仁时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属刘备或曹操势力】

逆天改命：【<刘备势力><与庞德关系等级至少为2级>收庞德为家将】
desc.en:
Liu Bei's Faction is at the height of its power, while Cao Cao's forces suffer setbacks in Hanzhong, leaving the realm in turmoil. Guan Yu marches north against Xiangfan, seeking to expand his victories...



Trigger Condition: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Guan Ping, Cao Cao, Cao Ren, and Sun Quan are alive. Chengdu and Hanzhong belong to Liu Bei, Xiangyang belongs to Cao Cao, and Jiangxia belongs to Sun Quan. Sun Quan's Faction has at least 5 Officers.



Restricted Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Mi Fang or Fu Shiren.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Liu Bei's or Cao Cao's Faction】



Defy Fate: 【<Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Pang De is at least Level 2> Recruit Pang De as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
连环计成，董卓伏诛，董氏一族在城中被残兵围捕，覆巢遗珠的董白在城中失了踪影…

禁忌条件：主角为董白、王允、李傕、吕布、董卓、曹操时无法触发。

亲历条件：【与董白的关系等级至少为1级且不足5级】，【主角参与连环计剧情】、【主角不属于曹操势力】，【董白、曹操存活，李傕为君主】

逆天改命：【阻止董白遭遇悲惨命运，使董白成为家将和恋人】
desc.en:
The Ensnare plot succeeded and Dong Zhuo was executed. The Dong clan was hunted down in the city by remnant soldiers, while Dong Bai—a pearl spared from the ruined nest—vanished without a trace...



Exclusion Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Dong Bai, Wang Yun, Li Jue, Lü Bu, Dong Zhuo, or Cao Cao.



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Dong Bai is at least Level 1 and below Level 5】, 【Protagonist participates in the Ensnare plot】, 【Protagonist does not belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Dong Bai and Cao Cao are alive, and Li Jue is a Ruler】



Defy Fate: 【Prevent Dong Bai from suffering a tragic fate, making Dong Bai a Retainer and Beloved】

desc.zh:
曹操年事已高，需要定立世子之位，三子争嗣，不知最后鹿死谁手。

禁忌条件：主角为曹植，曹丕，曹操，曹彰时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力（信义契约身份无效）】、【曹操关系等级达到2级】、【曹植，曹丕，曹操，曹彰存活】

逆天改命：【与三子的关系等级分别达到2级】帮助某位世子上位，或制衡三子以促成三家分魏。
desc.en:
Cao Cao grows old and must name his heir. With three sons vying for succession, none can tell who will ultimately prevail.



Restricted Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Zhi, Cao Pi, Cao Cao, or Cao Zhang.



Participation Requirements: 【Belongs to Cao Cao's Faction (Pact of Faith status invalid)】, 【Relationship level with Cao Cao reaches Level 2】, 【Cao Zhi, Cao Pi, Cao Cao, and Cao Zhang are alive】



Defy Fate: 【Relationship level with each of the three sons reaches Level 2】 Help one of the heirs take power, or balance all three to divide Wei into three realms.

desc.zh:
曹操请众人前来议事，却醉翁之意不在酒......

禁忌条件：主角为曹操，杨修时无法触发

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】、【曹操、杨修存活】、【与杨修关系等级小于5】

逆天改命：【<与杨修的关系等级至少为1级>救下杨修并使其成为家将】
desc.en:
Cao Cao invites everyone to deliberate, yet his true intentions lie elsewhere...



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao or Yang Xiu



Participation Requirements: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Cao Cao and Yang Xiu are alive】, 【Relationship level with Yang Xiu is less than 5】



Defy Fate: 【<Relationship level with Yang Xiu is at least Level 1> Rescue Yang Xiu and recruit him as a Retainer】

desc.zh:
建安廿三年，曹操召百官入朝，并商议立世子之事......

禁忌条件：主角不为曹操、曹丕、曹植、曹彰

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】【完成三子夺嫡】

逆天改命：【若参与过三子夺嫡大剧情，则可助指定的世子上位，甚至促成三家分魏】
desc.en:
In the 23rd year of Jianan, Cao Cao summons all court officials to discuss the naming of an heir...



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is not Cao Cao, Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, or Cao Zhang



Participation Requirements: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】【Complete Succession Struggle of the Three Sons】



Defy Fate: 【If you have participated in the major storyline Succession Struggle of the Three Sons, you can assist the chosen heir to power, or even bring about the Tripartite Division of Wei】

desc.zh:
建安廿五年，魏王操头疾笃，薨于邺城文昌殿，春秋六十有六。谥曰武王，葬高陵。是日邺中玄云四合，漳水为之不流。

禁忌条件：主角不为曹操。

亲历条件：【身属曹操势力】、【曹丕、曹植、曹彰为曹操麾下武将】、【许昌、邺、南皮属曹操】

逆天改命：【<身为曹操势力武将>宣布继承人并决定曹魏的未来】
desc.en:
In the 25th year of Jianan, Cao Cao, King of Wei, fell gravely ill with a headache and passed away in Wenchang Hall at Ye at the age of sixty-six. He was posthumously titled King Wu and buried in Gaoling. On that day, dark clouds gathered from all sides over Ye, and the River Zhang ceased to flow.



Ineligible Conditions: Protagonist is not Cao Cao.



Participation Conditions: 【Belong to Cao Cao's Faction】, 【Cao Pi, Cao Zhi, and Cao Zhang are Officers under Cao Cao】, 【Xuchang, Ye, and Nanpi belong to Cao Cao】



Defy Fate: 【<As an Officer of Cao Cao's Faction> Announce an heir and decide the future of Cao Wei】

desc.zh:
携手袁氏巾帼，智止兄弟阋墙之戈，共御强敌，于邺城之下书写乱世传奇......

禁忌条件：<邺城丽人>已完成。主角为曹操、曹丕、袁谭、袁熙、袁尚、高干、袁思阙、甄宓时无法触发。

亲历条件：【身属袁谭、袁熙、袁尚或高干势力】、【不为郭图、辛评、辛毗、审配、逢纪】、【与袁思阙的关系至少为2级】、【曹操势力存在】、【邺属袁尚】、【平原属袁谭】

逆天改命：【<与甄宓关系等级达到2级>救下甄宓可收为家将】、【<帮助袁氏重新统一>可收袁思阙为家将或使袁思阙成为主公】
desc.en:
Join hands with the heroine of the Yuan clan, wisely halt the fratricidal strife among brothers, resist formidable foes together, and forge a legend of this chaotic era beneath the walls of Yecheng...



Exclusion Condition: <Beauty of Yecheng> has been completed. Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Cao Pi, Yuan Tan, Yuan Xi, Yuan Shang, Gao Gan, Yuan Sique, or Zhen Mi.



Participation Condition: 【Belong to Yuan Tan, Yuan Xi, Yuan Shang, or Gao Gan Faction】, 【Not Guo Tu, Xin Ping, Xin Pi, Shen Pei, or Feng Ji】, 【Relationship with Yuan Sique is at least Level 2】, 【Cao Cao Faction exists】, 【Ye belongs to Yuan Shang】, 【Pingyuan belongs to Yuan Tan】



Defy Fate: 【<Relationship level with Zhen Mi reaches Level 2> Rescue Zhen Mi to recruit her as a Retainer】, 【<Help the Yuan clan reunite> Yuan Sique can be recruited as a Retainer or become My Liege】

desc.zh:
晚年的曹操噩梦频发，常说梦中有人献刀…

禁忌条件：主角为曹操、许褚、陈宫、董卓、吕布时无法触发

亲历条件：【与曹操关系等级至少为3级】且【身为曹操势力武将】
desc.en:
In his twilight years, Cao Cao was plagued by frequent nightmares, often saying that someone presented a saber in his dreams...



Ineligible Conditions: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Xu Chu, Chen Gong, Dong Zhuo, or Lu Bu



Participation Conditions: 【Relationship level with Cao Cao is at least 3】 and 【Serve as an Officer of Cao Cao's Faction】

name.en: No Intact Eggs in an Overturned Nest

desc.zh:
孔融因屡次触怒曹操，被路粹、郗虑罗织死罪。                                                                                                                               亲历条件：【与孔融关系等级≥2】、【孔融为曹操势力武将】

禁忌条件：主角为曹操，孔融，孔舒，王修，许褚，程昱时无法触发。

逆天改命： 【救下孔融、孔舒，使其避免死亡】；【<玩家不属曹操势力>使其成为家将】
desc.en:
Kong Rong, having repeatedly infuriated Cao Cao, was framed for capital crimes by Lu Cui and Xi Lu.                                                                                                                               Participation Condition: 【Relationship level with Kong Rong ≥ 2】, 【Kong Rong is an Officer of Cao Cao's Faction】



Restricted Condition: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Cao Cao, Kong Rong, Kong Shu, Wang Xiu, Xu Chu, or Cheng Yu.



Defy Fate: 【Save Kong Rong and Kong Shu to prevent their deaths】, 【<Player does not belong to Cao Cao's Faction> Recruit them as Retainers】

desc.zh:
汉室衰微，曹操专权，挟天子以令诸侯。伏皇后与父伏完密谋，欲除曹操以安汉室。

触发条件：伏皇后、刘协、曹操存活且身属正确势力。

亲历条件：【家将数量至少为1】且【与伏完关系等级至少为2级】。

禁忌条件：曹操、伏完、伏寿不为玩家家将，主角不为伏寿、刘协、伏完、伏德、曹操、华歆、许褚、董昭、程昱、贾诩。

逆天改命：【使伏皇后、伏完存活并使其成为家将】
desc.en:
The Han Dynasty waned and Cao Cao monopolized power, holding the emperor hostage to command the warlords in his name. Empress Fu secretly conspired with her father Fu Wan, plotting to eliminate Cao Cao and secure the Han house.



Trigger Condition: Empress Fu, Liu Xie, and Cao Cao are alive and belong to the correct Factions.



Participation Requirements: 【Number of Retainers is at least 1】 and 【Relationship level with Fu Wan is at least Level 2】.



Ineligible Conditions: Cao Cao, Fu Wan, and Fu Shou are not the player's Retainers, the protagonist is not Fu Shou, Liu Xie, Fu Wan, Fu De, Cao Cao, Hua Xin, Xu Chu, Dong Zhao, Cheng Yu, or Jia Xu.



Defy Fate: 【Keep Empress Fu and Fu Wan alive and recruit them as Retainers】

desc.zh: 曹操已取荆州，文聘因自责拒不出仕。
desc.en: Cao Cao has taken Jing Province, and Wen Pin refuses to Serve out of self-reproach.

biography.zh: 曹魏政权的缔造者，著名政治家、军事家、诗人。阉宦之后，少年时任侠放荡，不修品行，却展现非凡机智与权术，被名士许劭评为“治世之能臣，乱世之奸雄”。二十岁举孝廉，任洛阳北部尉，棒杀违禁的宦官蹇硕叔父。曾为汉骁骑校尉的曹操，立志匡扶汉室，在只身刺董失败后参与了袁绍的讨伐董卓计划，目睹了联军的各怀鬼胎后意识到汉室已不可挽救。迎立献帝后挟天子以令诸侯，先后消灭了吕布、张绣等割据势力，并在官渡之战中击败了曾经的好友袁绍，终统一北方，逐步掌控了汉帝国实权。企图统一全国，但在赤壁一役中被孙刘联军击败。后致力于向西征战，履获成效，最终平定了关中和汉中。建安二十年，进爵为魏王，设天子旌旗。建安二十五年，病死于洛阳，享年六十六岁。曹丕称帝后被追尊为太祖，谥号武皇帝。
biography.tc: 曹魏政權的締造者，著名政治家、軍事家、詩人。閹宦之后，少年時任俠放蕩，不修品行，卻展現非凡機智與權術，被名士許劭評為“治世之能臣，亂世之奸雄”。二十歲舉孝廉，任洛陽北部尉，棒殺違禁的宦官蹇碩叔父。曾為漢驍騎校尉的曹操，立志匡扶漢室，在只身刺董失敗后參與了袁紹的討伐董卓計劃，目睹了聯軍的各懷鬼胎后意識到漢室已不可挽救。迎立獻帝后挾天子以令諸侯，先后消滅了呂布、張繡等割據勢力，并在官渡之戰中擊敗了曾經的好友袁紹，終統一北方，逐步掌控了漢帝國實權。企圖統一全國，但在赤壁一役中被孫劉聯軍擊敗。后致力于向西征戰，履獲成效，最終平定了關中和漢中。建安二十年，進爵為魏王，設天子旌旗。建安二十五年，病死于洛陽，享年六十六歲。曹丕稱帝后被追尊為太祖，謚號武皇帝。
biography.en: Founder of the Cao Wei regime and a renowned statesman, military strategist, and poet. Descended from a eunuch family, in his youth he was chivalrous and dissolute, neglecting moral conduct, yet displayed extraordinary wit and political cunning. The famed critic Xu Shao assessed him as ‘a capable minister in times of peace, a crafty hero in times of chaos.’ At twenty he was nominated as Filial and Incorrupt and appointed Commandant of the Northern District of Luoyang, where he beat to death an uncle of the eunuch Jian Shuo for violating curfew. As a former Cavalry Commandant of the Han, Cao Cao aspired to restore the dynasty. After his solo assassination attempt on Dong Zhuo failed, he joined Yuan Shao's plan to subjugate Dong Zhuo, but witnessing the self-serving motives of the allied lords convinced him the Han could not be saved. He welcomed Emperor Xian and wielded imperial authority to command the lords, successively destroying the warlord forces of Lu Bu, Zhang Xiu, and others. At the Battle of Guandu he defeated his former friend Yuan Shao, ultimately unifying the north and gradually seizing real power over the Han Empire. He attempted to unite the entire realm but was defeated by the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei at the Battle of Red Cliffs. Afterward he turned his campaigns westward with great success, eventually pacifying Guanzhong and Hanzhong. In the 20th year of Jian'an, he was elevated to King of Wei and granted the imperial banner. In the 25th year of Jian'an, he died of illness at Luoyang at the age of sixty-six. After Cao Pi proclaimed himself emperor, Cao Cao was posthumously honored as Grand Progenitor with the temple name Taizu and the posthumous title Emperor Wu.
biography.jp: 曹魏政権の創始者であり、高名な政治家、軍事家、詩人。宦官の家系に生まれ、少年時代は任侠で放蕩に耽り、品行を修めなかったが、非凡な機知と権術を発揮し、名士の許劭から「治世の能臣、乱世の奸雄」と評された。二十歳で孝廉に推挙されて洛陽北部尉となり、法を犯した宦官・蹇碩の叔父を棒殺した。かつて漢の驍騎校尉であった曹操は漢室の再興を志し、単身での董卓暗殺に失敗した後は袁紹による董卓討伐計画に加わったが、連合軍の面々が各々腹に一物抱える様を目の当たりにし、漢室の救済はもはや不可能であると悟った。献帝を迎え入れた後は天子を擁して諸侯に号令し、呂布や張繍などの割拠勢力を次々と討滅。官渡の戦いではかつての親友であった袁紹を撃破し、ついに北方を統一して漢帝国の実権を掌握していった。天下統一を目論むも赤壁の戦いにて孫権・劉備の連合軍に敗北。その後は西への遠征に力を注いで成果を挙げ、最終的に関中と漢中を平定した。建安二十年、魏王に進爵し、天子の旌旗を立てた。建安二十五年、洛陽にて病没、享年六十六。曹丕の皇帝即位後に太祖と追尊され、諡号を武皇帝とされた。
biography.kr: 조위 정권의 기틀을 다진 창건자이자 저명한 정치가, 군사가, 시인이다. 환관 가문 출신으로 소년 시절에는 임협을 일삼고 방탕하여 행실을 닦지 않았으나, 비범한 기지와 권모술수를 발휘하여 명사 허소로부터 '치세의 능신, 난세의 간웅'이라는 평가를 받았다. 스무 살에 효렴으로 천거되어 낙양북부위에 제수되었으며, 금령을 위반한 환관 건석의 숙부를 방살하였다. 한나라의 효기교위였던 조조는 한실을 바로 세우고자 뜻을 품고 홀로 동탁을 암살하려다 실패한 뒤 원소의 동탁 토벌 계획에 참여했으나, 연합군이 각자 딴마음을 품은 것을 목격하고 한실을 더는 바로잡을 수 없음을 깨달았다. 헌제를 옹립한 후 천자를 끼고 제후를 호령하며 여포, 장수 등 각지의 할거 세력을 차례로 평정했고, 관도대전에서 과거의 친구였던 원소를 격파하여 마침내 북방을 통일하고 한 제국의 실권을 점차 장악해 나갔다. 천하 통일을 도모했으나 적벽대전에서 손권과 유비의 연합군에게 패배하였다. 이후 서쪽으로 정벌에 힘을 기울여 잇달아 성과를 거두었고, 마침내 관중과 한중을 평정하였다. 건안 20년에는 위왕으로 봉해져 천자의 깃발을 세웠다. 건안 25년, 낙양에서 병으로 세상을 떠나니 향년 66세였다. 조비가 칭제한 후 태조로 추존되었으며, 시호는 무황제이다.
